h1: Hello!My name is Michael Dolejš, and I am a graphic designer and partner at Studio Najbrt (and sometimes work on projects with my wife Karla). I'm interested in visual communication and its overlaps between digital design, motion design, and print.
Feel free to contact me for work inquiry or any other opportunities at michael@najbrt.cz

/about.title: michaeldolejs.com
/about.description: Graphic Designer from Prague interested in user interface & experience design, but also in visual identities, communication & strategy.
h1: Michael Dolejš (*1992) is a graphic designer with a keen interest in exploring the dynamic overlaps between digital, print and communication be it websites, apps, logotypes or visual identity systems.

He graduated from Faculty of Arts of University of West Bohemia in 2017 and started working with Studio Najbrt in the same year. He recently became a partner.Apart from freelancing for many clients, he also worked in-house with many companies such as Ableton, STRV or Cleevio.
Feel free to contact me for work inquiry or any other opportunities at michael@najbrt.cz
